name: library
description: A zero-dependency Node package: one public surface, one unit lane on node:test.
layout: - `src/` - the library. `index.mjs` is the only public surface; everything else is reachable through it. Open it to change behavior.
- `test/` - the unit lane, `node --test` over `*.test.mjs`. No framework, no fixtures. Open it to add a test.
- `package.json` - the package manifest and the `test` script the unit lane runs.

lanes.INTEGRATION_CMD: not wired: this template has no integration lane yet
lanes.E2E_CMD: not wired: a library has no e2e lane
lanes.LIVE_CMD: not wired: add one the day this library calls a model
